messages:
Priya: Who ate the communal granola jar?? I opened it and its half gone and someone added a sticky note that says 'for research'. :face_with_raised_eyebrow:

Ben: That was me. I did a taste test. Research is important. :nerd_face: Sorry, I'll replace it before EOD.

Lina: Please replace with the gluten-free one if possible. Someone in design is allergic and weve been trying to keep one jar GF.

Rey: Also heads-up: coffee filters are nearly out. The box under the sink is empty. Could we put a small rota for coffee supplies?

Priya: Good call. Could we do a shared checklist in the kitchen? 2 items max: filters + oat milk.

Ava: I made a tiny sign people can stick on the shelf — 'If you take, please replace within 48h' and a QR to a Google Sheet. Will tape it up now.

SnackRobo: [automated] Pantry inventory update: granola (regular) = 1/2 jar, granola (GF) = 0 jars, coffee filters = 6 remaining, oat milk = 1 carton. Suggested restock: granola GF, filters.

Ben: I can grab GF granola on my way out at 17:10. Also will put a note on the jar: 'Ben owes granola'. :grimacing:

Lina: Love the accountability jar idea. Maybe next time we do 'donation-dollar' for snacks? small $1 box for premium items.

Rey: For now, filter rota: week 1 = Priya, week 2 = Ben, week 3 = Lina. I'll DM a calendar invite so it doesn't disappear.

Priya: Thanks — if anyone sees the mystery 'research' note author, roast them mercilessly. :rofl:
